message: こういう時だけ神頼み
Today is the meeting with the people from the shopping district.

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder if the meeting will go well」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What are you getting nervous about now? We know everybody there, so there's no reason it wouldn't go well, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I guess you're right」
Guys like Tame-san might even throw us a lifeline, too.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, if anything happens, just leave it to this Shooting Star Shopping District Belle!」

name: Paqy
message: 「The fact that it's not 'Shooting Star Belle' makes the area of effect subtly narrow」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And that remark from you is subtly rude」

name: Synn
message: 「Now, now, no fighting. Huh...?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's up, Synn?」
Spotted Azel pacing back and forth in front of a clothing store.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh. So even she does stuff like that」

name: Synn
message: 「Stuff like what?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Isn't it obvious?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Totally obvious」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh... I'm the only one who doesn't get it...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「'That outfit's so nice, so cute, but it's expensive, though maybe just trying it on... Just because I try it on doesn't mean I have to buy it right now...'」

name: Nanaka
message: 「'But if I don't buy it now, someone else might buy it, but, but it's expensive... Uuuuuugh'」

name: Paqy
message: 「She's agonizing over it just like that」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, seriously agonizing over it like that is part of the fun. Remember that a maiden's shopping takes time!」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that how it is?! I always had the image that you make snap decisions and buy things right away no matter what, Nanaka...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Which means, ya know, Soba here isn't a girl」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What was that?! Even I agonize over whether to buy clothes or not!」

name: Synn
message: 「I thought you were investing your entire fortune into cake」

name: Paqy
message: 「Your money all turns into sweets, so you don't even have any left to buy clothes, right? Trying to look cool is pretty pathetic」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Grrr. You stupid panda!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Spam!」
I see. So Azel enjoys that sort of thing too.
If that's the case, I'd feel bad calling out to her.

name: Synn
message: 「Oops. If we don't hurry, we're going to be late for the meeting!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wawah! Is it that late already!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Saved by the bell......」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Let's hurry! You really are hopeless without me around, Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「How did you jump to that conclusion?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「See, everything went smoothly, didn't it? Hmph」

name: Paqy
message: 「It ain't really something for you to puff your chest out over」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, I guess that's true, yeah」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not true. It's thanks to you too, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, Synn, you! Flattering me won't get you anything!」
I smoothly dodge Nanaka as she tries to slap me on the back.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mmph. Expected nothing less from my childhood friend」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I can at least read a move like that...... Huh?」
I spot Azel pacing back and forth in front of the clothing store again.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa. That girl's still here!?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's been three hours, hasn't it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even at my absolute worst, I only agonize for twenty minutes......」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's pretty short considering you were just saying how fun it is to agonize over things」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm an Edokko through and through!」

name: Synn
message: 「You're a Ryuuseikko, though」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even so, are you really that curious about her, Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, of course I'm curious.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmm... Curious, huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, I think mine are bigger, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「What?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If you keep peeking out from behind cover like this, people are gonna think you're a creep!」

name: Synn
message: 「I know, but...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I won't let you peek while she's trying things on as long as I'm still breathing!」

name: Synn
message: 「As if I would! Oh...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-What?」
Azel stopped dead in her tracks, started to step toward the clothing store...
Then paused, as if realizing something.
Giving her head a slight shake, she turned right around and marched off as if she were angry.

name: Synn
message: 「She left...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be... she doesn't have enough money? I hear girls' clothes are crazy expensive.」

name: Paqy
message: 「The less fabric there is, the pricier it gets. Like swimsuits, for instance.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that so...」

name: Paqy
message: 「If Ria―chan wore one of those string swimsuits, the great me would―」

name: Paqy
message: 「Bikini!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That has nothing to do with this.」

name: Synn
message: 「So she's out of money...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're one to talk, Synn. You're always broke.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh, right where it hurts」

name: Nanaka
message: 「In Azel's case, it's probably not all the time--just today by chance」

name: Synn
message: 「That hurts even more! Still, you know, Azel bought a whole mountain of Vandine Jelly before, too.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Now that you mention it, yeah」

name: Synn
message: 「I knew it, she really doesn't have any money」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, no matter how you slice it, there's no way she has less than you, Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「That's... impossible! That's way too harsh! No way!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What do you mean, 'no way'... So, what are you gonna do?」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean, what am I gonna do? Today's Student Council activities are over」
I'm worried about Azel, though...

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey. Wanna go to Asukai Shrine?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's out of the blue」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That place is like the guardian deity around here, right? I was thinking maybe we could go pray for KiraFes to be a success」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh. Nice. I like that」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Phew... thank goodness」

name: Synn
message: 「About what?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, you've been acting weirdly hung up on that girl, Synn, so I was worried you were thinking of tailing her or something」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not like I'm a stalker」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'd hate to see my childhood friend get hauled off in cuffs, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't worry about weird stuff like that」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, could it be that we're...」

name: Synn
message: 「Say no more」

name: Paqy
message: 「In the end, you're both stalkers」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's just a coincidence!」

name: Synn
message: 「Shh」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Well, we couldn't help it」
We happened to spot Azel on the way to the shrine. And she was heading in the same direction.

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're the one who hid first, Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「That was... just kind of a reflex」
Azel, who had been standing still, started walking briskly.
And here we are, tiptoeing right behind him.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even so, where do you think he's planning to go?」

name: Synn
message: 「Isn't he heading back to the dorms?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「He's definitely heading toward the academy, sure, but... he's been stopping over and over again for a while now」

name: Paqy
message: 「He's looking for a house to burglarize. Being a mysterious transfer student and all.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Daura!」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be that, just like us, he's going to KiraFes--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No way that's it\s02」
It feels a bit lonely when she shuts it down so flatly, though she's probably right.

name: Synn
message: 「Oh?」
Azel stopped again.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Standing still like that and staring intently at the ground... I wonder if there's some kind of meaning to it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Meaning?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Like a ritual to summon Nyarlathotep or something?」

name: Synn
message: 「What's that」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It kind of looks like it, doesn't it」
Azel starts walking. And so do we.
What is this?
A strange, ticklish feeling... like the corner of my head is itching just a little.
The spot where Azel stopped?

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's up, Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Nanaka...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If we don't hurry, we're going to lose sight of him」

name: Synn
message: 「...Yeah」
Does Nanaka not feel anything at all. Maybe it's just my imagination……?

name: Nanaka
message: 「Could it be just like Synn guessed?」

name: Synn
message: 「About what?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Look」
Azel had stopped in front of the torii gate. He is staring intently at the ground.

name: Synn
message: 「Still, it doesn't really feel like he's here to pray」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then, a retaliatory visit?」

name: Synn
message: 「Why!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then, a curse at the hour of the ox?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's still bright out」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh. Lord Azel」

name: Shio
message: 「Have you come to worship today?　Lord Fujitakanasumi-no-Mikoto welcomes all who visit without discrimination, at any time whatsoever」

name: Shio
message: 「Lord Azel?」

name: Shio
message: 「Could it be that you are feeling unwell?」
Azel suddenly raised his head.
Glancing briefly at Shio-chan, he turned on his heel just like that and walked away.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Guess he wasn't here to pray」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah」

name: Shio
message: 「My, if it isn't Lord Synn and Lady Nanaka」
Whoops, we got spotted.

name: Synn
message: 「Uh…… h-hello」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Act like you belong」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, but」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We came here to pray for success, so that makes us proper guests, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hiya」

name: Synn
message: 「Hello, Shio-chan」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey. We came to pray for KiraFes to succeed, so does this place offer blessings for that kind of thing too?」

name: Shio
message: 「Of course. For the divine efficacy of the gods knows no bounds.」
May KiraFes succeed, and may everyone at the academy be brimming with sparkle and excitement......

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey. What kind of blessings does this place actually have? Sorry to ask now of all times」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry from me too. I don't know either.」

name: Shio
message: 「Not at all. That is merely proof of how well our shrine has blended into this land. It is truly something to be grateful for.」

name: Shio
message: 「Ahem.」

name: Shio
message: 「Here at Asukai Shrine, we enshrine Fujitakanasumi-no-Mikoto as our principal deity, offering blessings for the warding off of evil spirits, academic success, safe childbirth, the return of good fortune, opening the way to luck, attracting wealth, finding lost--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「In short, you handle pretty much anything a shrine could possibly handle, huh」

name: Synn
message: 「It was that amazing of a shrine?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is that really something to be impressed by?」

name: Synn
message: 「Come to think of it, earlier you told Azel 'today for sure,' right」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, now that you mention it...... does that mean」

name: Shio
message: 「Lord Azel has visited this place a few times before.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is he always like that?」

name: Shio
message: 「Yes.」
Shio-chan let out a wry smile.

name: Shio
message: 「To have been seen by the two of you saying something like 'today for sure' fills me with utmost shame.」

name: Shio
message: 「Everyone has their own reasons for coming here, and forcing them is hardly praiseworthy conduct for one serving as a shrine maiden.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Everyone has their own reasons, huh......」
Well, I suppose that's true.

name: Synn
message: 「You know that Azel is a transfer student, right?」

name: Shio
message: 「Beyond that, I know almost nothing.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm going to ask anyway, though. From your perspective, Shio-chan, what kind of person do you think Azel is?」

name: Shio
message: 「I have scarcely spoken with Lord Azel, nor have I heard anything of particular note about him, so I cannot speak beyond my mere impressions, however」

name: Synn
message: 「That's fine with me」
Shio-chan thought it over for a while before muttering.

name: Shio
message: 「...He seems to be a rather clumsy sort of person, indeed」

name: Synn
message: 「Clumsy?」

name: Shio
message: 「That is merely how he appears to me, and as I am still inexperienced, I cannot say for certain whether I am judging him accurately」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, he definitely doesn't seem like a smooth operator. Or rather, the type who makes enemies easily?」

name: Shio
message: 「It is hardly solid proof, but there was a martial artist acquainted with my grandfather who carried that very same air about him」

name: Synn
message: 「You mean Azel seems like he's mastered something like that too?」
Shio-chan shook her head once.

name: Shio
message: 「No, that is not what I mean. Besides, as I dabble a little in the martial arts myself, I can tell that Azel-dono does not engage in training of that sort」

name: Shio
message: 「It is just, how should I put it... It seems that those who think or wish for only a single thing tend to become inept at everything else」

name: Shio
message: 「The person I mentioned as resembling Azel-dono was just such a man」

name: Shio
message: 「A 'seeker'... I believe that word would be fitting」

name: Shio
message: 「I have gone and spouted off my rather unhelpful insights so smugly. I am still far too immature」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I only sort of get it, but it was helpful」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Azel, a seeker, huh...」

name: Shio
message: 「Come to think of it, is the Student Council still dabbling in exterminating mononoke?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, every now and then...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Look, it's just, you aren't always around, Shio-chan」

name: Shio
message: 「Indeed. However, to be unable to sense their presence shows that I am still far too inexperienced. I must train even harder!」

name: Shio
message: 「Everyone on the Student Council must take care as well. Lately, the covert activities of the mononoke have grown increasingly fierce」

name: Shio
message: 「Just last night, they finally showed their hideous forms even within the sacred grounds of this very shrine...!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What!」

name: Synn
message: 「Was there any damage?」

name: Shio
message: 「No. Before those fiends could do anything, I discovered them and averted any trouble」

name: Synn
message: 「Were you okay, Shio-chan」

name: Shio
message: 「Ha-ha-ha. Those scoundrels must have my fearsome reputation engraved upon their hearts. They scattered and fled at the mere sight of me」
Less like they fled, and more like they got sick of dealing with it and went home.

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I see. That's a relief~」

name: Shio
message: 「I am most humbled and honored by your words of praise. Please take care not to push yourselves too hard or act recklessly either」

name: Synn
message: 「Same goes for you, Shio-chan」

name: Shio
message: 「Hahaha, worry not! Leave the peace of Ryuusei Town to me!」
Watching Shio-chan strike a cool pose.
I thought to myself that sometimes it's better not to know the truth.
